assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A Ruby parser adversarial-testing setup, execution commands, and retained failure inputs.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A Ruby parser adversarial-testing setup, execution commands, and retained failure inputs.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A Ruby adversarial-input fuzzing harness, runnable test commands, and a failure-input retention mechanism.
assessments.rationale: It provides release-oriented testing process gates, but no concrete adversarial-input harness, Ruby test command, or mechanism to preserve failure-revealing inputs.
It provides Ruby-specific coverage-guided fuzzing, harness examples, execution commands, corpus support, and libFuzzer crash artifacts that preserve failing inputs.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: An automated Ruby parser fuzzing harness, team run commands, and failure-input retention.
